svg.title: Iskra proposes, Szlif evaluates — paired interaction vignette
svg.desc: Iskra the fox proposes, Szlif the raven evaluates with a plan notebook. Composed from the master pair with deterministic transforms.
svg.title: Szlif — master raven vector (direction A refined, with plan notebook)
svg.desc: Iskra the fox proposes, Szlif the raven evaluates with a plan notebook. Composed from the master pair with deterministic transforms.
svg.title: Szlif — design direction A, perched thinker with a swept crest
svg.desc: Szlif the raven: wedge head tilted down with a massive straight ochre bill and a short down hook, flat crown with three broad raked-back crest feathers, shaggy throat hackles, broad shoulders tapering to a narrow rump, folded wing with stepped primary tips breaking the back outline, long wedge tail, bent bird legs, and a turquoise plan notebook gripped in a talon. Flat vector, five colours.
svg.title: Iskra — master fox vector (direction A refined)
svg.desc: Iskra the fox proposes, Szlif the raven evaluates with a plan notebook. Composed from the master pair with deterministic transforms.
svg.title: Iskra — design direction A, soft-round three-quarter sitter
svg.desc: Iskra the fox: soft-round construction, projecting snout, small almond eyes, asymmetric lock of hair sweeping over the far eye with a cowlick tuft, turquoise scarf passing under the chin and round the neck with a bulky knot and an end hanging over the shoulder, one raised foreleg with a cream mitten, broad plume tail with a cream tip. Flat vector, five colours.
